messages:
Anika (People Ops): Hey folks — planning a small 'micro-ceremony' program for spot award winners next month. Idea: ship a lightweight kit (pin + sticker + postcard) + automated personalized PDF certificate emailed with a short video clip link. Need input on logistics, vendor, tax forms for international, and design for certificate template. Target send window: May 12-16. Who can support pickups/packaging? :sparkles:
Leo (People Ops): Love it. Estimate how many recipients? We should also include an opt-out for home addresses.
Anika (People Ops): Roughly 120 global recipients (US 60, EU 30, APAC 30). Budget request w/ quotes coming. Packaging: small padded mailer.
Ravi (Facilities): I can reserve the small conference room for 2 half-days packing on May 9-10. Need count per shift.
Sam (Logistics): I'll contact LocalFulfill for a fulfillment quote. They can do kitting + international postage. ETA for quote 48h.
Maya (Finance): FYI tax team asked if awards >$100 need reporting in certain countries. Can we cap item value under $50? Also need cost center code.
Anika (People Ops): Good call. We'll keep item value low. Cost center: PO-ENG-RECOG.
Leo (People Ops): For certificates — can design produce a templated PDF with placeholder fields? Ideally automated via Zapier/SendGrid or internal SMTP. @Design, cc'd.
Anika (People Ops): @Design — can you make 2 certificate sizes: printable 8.5x11 and mobile-friendly image? Simple brand + signer field.
DesignBot: Uploaded a mock to /drive/recog/certificates/mock_v1.png. Feedback welcome. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Logistics): LocalFulfill quote 1) kitting + domestic postage $3.20/unit 2) international avg $8.50/unit incl tracking. Minimum lead time 7 business days.
Maya (Finance): Approve budget up to $2,000 for this run (covers kit + shipping). Finance needs final headcount by May 1.
Anika (People Ops): Action items: Sam finalize quote by EOD Tue; Leo coordinate volunteer shifts; Ravi book room; Design iterate cert; Maya confirm tax guidance. Can volunteers reply with preferred shift times?
Leo (People Ops): I'll take the morning May 9 shift (9–12). @Ravi can you block the room?
Ravi (Facilities): Done — CONF ROOM B booked May 9 9–12 and May 10 13–17. :white_check_mark:
Sonal (People Ops): I can help pack May 10 afternoon. Also can own the email send list and opt-out column.
Anika (People Ops): Perfect. Also need a CSV template for recipients: please include columns: email, full_name, postal_address1, city, region, country, item_opt_out (yes/no), award_date, cert_signer. Paste below example CSV header.
Sam (Logistics): ```email,full_name,postal_address1,city,region,country,item_opt_out,award_date,cert_signer
alex@example.com,Alex Kim,123 Market St,San Francisco,CA,USA,no,2026-05-12,Anika
```
Leo (People Ops): Quick Q — for APAC shipments, any customs paperwork? Ravi?
Ravi (Facilities): Usually not for low-value gifts, but we'll include a CN22 marking 'gift' and value. Sam to confirm with LocalFulfill.
Maya (Finance): Also double-check US payroll reporting thresholds. I will follow up with payroll and add note to the final email.
Anika (People Ops): Thanks team. If no objections I'll move ahead with vendor and schedule sends. Will post final cost and headcount by May 1. :rocket:
Leo (People Ops): SGTM :+1:
